f1_2025.description: 2022-2025 ground-effect F1 car with DRS. Grip and downforce calibrated to five 2025 pole laps (RMS error 1.8%). The MGU-H let these cars deploy the MGU-K for most of a lap, so full power is available throughout.

f1_2026.description: 2026 regulations, derived from the calibrated 2025 car using published targets: 768 kg, ~30% less downforce, ~55% less drag in straight-line mode, narrower tyres, ~400 kW ICE + 350 kW MGU-K limited to ~8.5 MJ per lap and tapering to zero between 290 and 355 kph. Not calibrated against real 2026 laps.
